overview: A hiring and training roster app for a store's roadie crew, with roadie cards, paperwork, orientation, training groups, leader talks and opening-week questions.
features: Plan and track leader talk groups for opening-week training
See which roadies have not been met yet
Fill a group from roadies who are not in a talk yet
Edit and delete talk groups with a confirm step
See each roadie's talk day on their card
Record and clear final sign-offs that update stage tags right away
